name: generated-agent-set
body: The repo-defined code-writer agents the `agent-builder` scaffolds into a project's `.opencode/agents/**` and commits on the main checkout: the core/root `implementer`, one `<name>-implementer` per detected subsystem (naming convention `<name>-implementer.md`), and tiered `test-implementer`s where a test tier is file-separable. Membership follows whether the agent needs the repo's own source paths, build gates, and edit grants. The optional `coordinator` primary agent and the distributed `implementation-phase-reviewer` fall outside this set. Every generated agent's frontmatter holds `mode: subagent` and `hidden: true`: the `generated` field is absent, its apg-generated origin living in apg-internal bookkeeping.
